The best weeks for outdoor parties are here — soft sunshine on the lawn, comfortable evenings on the deck and the pool getting ready for the season. Book a day out, a family lunch or a spring party.
Weekend dates go first.

headline: Pool party ki dates abhi lo
sub: Private pool with a kids' section
text:
March aate hi pool party ki demand double. ☀️
Lock your date early: a private pool with a separate kids' section, a sun deck, lawn games, a barbecue and music till 10 pm as per local rules. Only your group on the property.
Ask for spring and summer dates.

headline: Dil dosti ka bhi hota hai
text:
Valentine's sirf couples ke liye kyun? 💛
Gather the girls (or the whole gang) for brunch by the pool, a photo corner on the deck, music on the lawn and a sleepover in 3 bedrooms. Décor and food partners can be arranged.
One group at a time — your crew only.

headline: Pyaar ho, aur jagah bhi khaas
text:
Happy Valentine's Day! ❤️ To every couple, every family and every friendship — may your day be full of love.
Planning a proposal, an anniversary or a wedding this year? Our private farmhouse is ready when you are.
